card.name: Sleep and circadian rhythm disorder text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or brackets right after sleep-wake and circadian terms, such as Non-24, delayed sleep phase, nighttime sleep disturbances, or the circadian clock. Also seen near bedtime and work-shift timing.

modes.label: After Non-24 or sleep disorder names
modes.description: A bracket or linking word follows a sleep-wake disorder name in a dosing table or heading.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Indicated Population Dosage Form Body Weight Recommended Dosage Non-24<< (>> 2.2 ) Adults Capsules

modes.label: Circadian clock and sleep phase wording
modes.description: A linking word comes inside a phrase about circadian rhythm, sleep phase or the body clock.
modes.example: PER2 (period homolog 2, Dosophila), Chromosome 2, “is a key component of<< the>> mammalian circadian clock machinery.”

modes.label: Bedtime and shift timing
modes.description: A linking word appears in dosing text tied to bedtime or work-shift timing.
modes.example: approximately 1 hour prior to the start of<< their>> work shift.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about body and soul, such as body, bodies, soul, and their Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in text about sleep cycles and the body clock.
